notes.title: New stage & save update!
notes.notes:
Main update!

- A new stage and Monsters have been added!
(The gameplay is getting longer and traps and creepy dungeons are waiting for you!)

- Now, each stage is saved. (Autosaved when a player arrives at next stage)

We are in a difficult situation as small indie developers, but we will continue to update as possible to provide a better game.

We will be a developer who works harder for players.

Thank you for playing our game.

notes.title: Package Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello.

To give more gamers a chance to experience our games, we provide our package at a lower price than ever before.

We hope many gamers will enjoy our game more and please give us a lot of attention.

We are having a "Review Free Code" event, so please give us a lot of attention and participate.

Please refer to the 'Review Event' notice for details.

Thank you.

notes.title: Review Event!
notes.notes:
Hello.

We are small indie developers.

Thank you for playing our game.

We fixed and updated about some glitches of Summoner series and are working on the next game project.
We expect it to be released in April.

It is an adventure game of fantasy genre like a fairy tale, and it has excellent graphics that everyone will like. 
We are very focused on implementing features to make it a great game.

To make this game perfect, we're going to refer to the elements that were praised in the previous game.

But there was a lack of reference to what elements were fun and novel in the previous game.

If you leave comments on what was good about SummonerVR, it will help us create the next game.

If you could give your comments to CUSTOMER REVIEWS on the Corrupted Hospital and Silent Mention Store page,
We're going to draw the some of good reviews and send you the game key for the next game.

If you write the good review on the both games, we will send you the key of the next game.

PS. Those who have already written will be included in the draw!

Thank you!

notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
Hello

Today's updates.

- Fixed bugs and inconveniences.
- The brightness has been adjusted to make the hints in the game more noticeable.
- We've optimized the game to make it run smoothly.
- The speed of movement of the player has been adjusted.
- The "healing beads (yellow)" from the witch in the battle against the final witch will fill you up HP more.

notes.title: Movement fix & Updates
notes.notes:
Hello.

- Slow walking problem on 'HTC VIVE' and 'VIVE COSMOS' devices has been fixed.
(It can happen very little depending on your computer's specifications, but you can enjoy the game enough.)

- The hints have been changed to make them more visible.
- The lantern angle has been comfortably fixed.
- The battle of Erina became a little easier.

Thank you.

notes.title: Support Valve Index
notes.notes:
Hello.

Now our game supports Valve Index and VIVE COSMOS (Joystic touch works well)

Thank you!

notes.title: Save & Updates
notes.notes:
Hello!

Save function has been updated.

- The game is automatically saved once on the second floor of the mansion.
- Some bugs have been fixed.
- The last boss, Erina, is a little easier than before.

Thank you.
